EXPEDITE DENIED

May 11, 2026
RE: SHN-[REDACTED]

We denied your request for an expedited hearing.

The reason for denial is listed below. For a free interpretation of the letter please call 800-743-8525.

You have requested an expedited state hearing to dispute the denial of a request for reimbursement. You state you need an expedited hearing because you are facing an imminent medical emergency due to your inability to pay out-of-network specialists. You have not provided any information concerning the urgency to receive the requested benefit. Based on the information provided, there is insufficient information to support that you qualify for an expedited hearing at this time where it must be shown that taking the time for a standard resolution could seriously jeopardize the enrollee's life, physical or mental health, or ability to attain, maintain or regain maximum function. If you have additional information concerning the urgency for a hearing decision, you can send us a copy of the documentation, or information and we will reconsider your expedite request. The best way to send your information and/or documentation is in writing at ScopeOfBenefits@dss.ca.gov.

Your case will be heard on a regular hearing calendar. You will get a separate notice of your hearing date and time.

If you think we made a mistake or your situation changes, you can ask again. We may need proof of your reason.

If you have any questions about this letter you may call 800-743-8525, or contact the State Hearings Division in one of the ways below:

• Online Appeals Account: https://acms.dss.ca.gov/acms/
• Email: ScopeOfBenefits@dss.ca.gov
• Fax Number: 833-281-0903
• Mail To: (Allow at least 5 days for mailing. Keep your originals.)
